plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: the bottle anchors the left, the big '30% OFF' headline stack fills the centre, and the brand lockup sits above the CTA in a right-hand action column, with legal as a quiet footer line under the copy.
Copy-first reading order: brand logo top-left with legal tucked beneath it, then the headline stack with the CTA directly under it as one block, and a large bottle on the right as the visual payoff.

Three-column layout with the product in the middle: a left column of logo over headline copy, the bottle as the central focal point, and a right column of CTA over legal so the action and its terms sit together.
